page: Microsoft Azure M128pds_v4 is a high-capacity, memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed within the Mpdsv4 family. Powered by the arm64 processor architecture under Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, this server features 128 dedicated vCPUs with dedicated physical allocation. Memory allocation is scaled to 1388.0 GB, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 10.84 GB per vCPU, which places it firmly into the memory-optimized tier.

The instance incorporates 7559 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, offering extensive high-throughput scratch space alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The system operates without discrete graphics accelerators, directing all power and host interconnect resources exclusively toward CPU processing, high memory density, and local disk throughput.

From an architectural standpoint, the use of dedicated ARM64 cores combined with high RAM density offers a qualitative cost and resource efficiency advantage compared to traditional x86 alternatives of comparable size. The primary tradeoff lies in software ecosystem alignment, as binary compatibility requires ARM64-compiled runtimes and operating systems, and x86-specific instruction sets are not present.

With its combination of 128 cores, 1.38 TB of RAM, and more than 7.5 TB of low-latency local NVMe storage, the M128pds_v4 is tailored for enterprise-scale in-memory databases, large relational database engines, real-time analytics platforms, and intensive extract-transform-load (ETL) processing pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure M128pds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine driven by 128 dedicated arm64 vCPUs and Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Built for memory-heavy workloads, the instance delivers 1388.0 GB of system memory, achieving an allocation of 10.84 GB per vCPU. Storage capabilities include a massive 7559 GB local NVMe SSD configuration alongside compatibility with Azure Premium Storage, ensuring rapid input/output operations for local temporary state. The instance does not feature discrete GPUs, optimizing platform resources purely for memory capacity, storage speed, and dedicated ARM processor threads. By utilizing an ARM-based compute architecture, the instance provides efficient resource consolidation at high density, although workloads must be native to arm64 environments. The M128pds_v4 is engineered for large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, relational database hosting, real-time analytics engines, and high-throughput data processing workflows.
